subject: ela
intro: Write routinely for various tasks and time frames.

items.prompt:
Which task needs an EXTENDED time frame?
A) a research report
B) a quick journal entry
C) a one-sentence answer

steps: Research takes time. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A quick journal entry is a:
A) short time-frame task
B) extended project
C) research paper

Writing regularly helps it become a:
A) routine habit
B) one-time event
C) rare task

Why do longer projects need REFLECTION and revision time?
A) to improve ideas, add evidence, and strengthen the draft
B) to waste time
C) to avoid finishing
items.answer: A) to improve ideas, add evidence, and strengthen the draft

steps: Time improves quality. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) to improve ideas, add evidence, and strengthen the draft

items.prompt:
Which is a SHORT time-frame writing task?
A) a quick in-class response to a reading
B) a month-long research paper
C) a full novel
items.answer: A) a quick in-class response to a reading

solution.answer: A) a quick in-class response to a reading

items.prompt:
Writing for a RANGE of discipline-specific tasks helps a student:
A) become a more flexible, skilled writer
B) only write one way
C) avoid practice
items.answer: A) become a more flexible, skilled writer

steps: Variety builds skill. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) become a more flexible, skilled writer

items.prompt:
A student has two weeks to research, draft, and revise an essay. The BEST approach is to:
A) spread the work across the time, leaving room to revise
B) write it all the night before
C) skip revision
items.answer: A) spread the work across the time, leaving room to revise

steps: Use the extended frame. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) spread the work across the time, leaving room to revise

items.prompt:
Why does the standard call for BOTH short and extended writing?
A) different tasks and purposes require different amounts of time
B) short writing is useless
C) long writing is always better
items.answer: A) different tasks and purposes require different amounts of time

steps: Match time to task. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) different tasks and purposes require different amounts of time
